li.label: ergonomically singularized
li.description: I was dragged into a singularity and then it exploded, and it was the most comfortable thing that has ever happened to me.

lines.li: I can't believe how comfortable that was!
Wow, that was so ergonomic!
My lower back has never felt better.
Finally, lumbar support that understands me.
Every vertebra is exactly where it should be.
I was compressed to a point and it was lovely.
Ten out of ten. Would be singularized again.
Best my posture has been in years.
It cradled me. The explosion cradled me.
I feel aligned. Spiritually and spinally.
My wrists have stopped hurting. Everything has.
Somebody finally designed something for people.
Like a hug from the whole neighbourhood at once.
I think my spine just thanked me.
Is this what furniture feels like?
Gravity, but considerate.
I would like to leave a glowing review.
All my joints clicked into place on the way in.
I've been squeezed and I've been singularized. Singularized wins.
Can we do that again, but slower?
Like a massage from a black hole.
My chiropractor is going to be furious.
I didn't know being crushed could be so supportive.
Perfectly contoured. Every inch of me.
Get me the name of that grenade. I want to write it a letter.
